annotations.title: English summary of a Korean DART filing: what happened, key figures, parties, dates

description: Use when an agent needs a Korean corporate disclosure in English. Input: rcept_no (14-digit DART receipt number from /v1/kr/filings). Output: JSON with headline, what_happened, key_figures (amounts, ratios, share counts with units), parties, key_dates, why_it_matters, confidence, original Korean title and DART link. Machine-generated paraphrase, not the official text. Unknown rcept_no or model outage is refused before payment. Use instead: kr_filings for finding the rcept_no. Example: ?rcept_no=20261030801383 Price: $0.02 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.
